vacancy.title: Secure Connectivity System Architecture Engineer
vacancy.assessment: New direct ESA ESTEC A2-A4 systems-architecture role, published 28 Oct 2026. Defines overall IRIS² system-of-systems architecture, segment interfaces, requirements traceability, technical budgets and system reviews. MSc plus four years relevant experience required. Direct ESA access and multidisciplinary systems/project-management overlap are positives, but specialised 5G, satcom constellation architecture and security experience are substantial gaps; senior specialist stretch, not a mechanical-design role. Four-year appointment extendable to indefinite. Official closing date 11 Nov 2026.
